rationale: It is hard to be certain here. The two pathways might run in parallel, in which case the cross readouts would be unchanged, but considerable literature argues for crosstalk, so a decrease in pERK after Akt inhibition would also be defensible, and a feedback-driven increase in pAkt after UO126 cannot be excluded either. I report unchanged for both cross readouts as the slightly more likely option. The on-target readouts probably fall, though partial inhibition or recovery by the day of harvest could leave them close to untreated levels.
